loss_reduction_contract.actor_loss: sum_real_requests w_x * [mean_G clipped_policy_loss_xg + lambda_t * CE_x + beta * exact_joint_KL_x] / N_real

task_stage_ce.note: Schedule candidate; family weights are authoritative in reward contract.

common_policy_contract.note: Registered initial comparison design; numerical settings require task-finalization and engineering acceptance before release lock. No task-specific reward inferred here.

action_membership.baseline: all configured valid output coordinates, including coordinates with masked or zero reward; padding is excluded
action_membership.same_input_reward_ablation: Q-input and Q-credit keep the same action-coordinate membership and exact KL contract
action_membership.partial_supervision: A missing process label masks its reward/CE term; it does not silently remove that coordinate from joint ratio or KL.
action_membership.cross_menu_caveat: Direct vs Q-input changes joint clipping and total KL geometry as well as input structure and compute.

ppo_critic_v1.design_correction: Earlier raw R-V description omitted whitening in the pinned referenced function. This correction changes no implemented or running trainer.

rloo_v1.note: RLOO advantage with PPO clipping; explicitly distinguish from an unclipped REINFORCE-RLOO implementation.

clipping_geometry.scope: separate diagnostic objective; Final-only factorized reward can marginalize irrelevant auxiliary actions before clipping
clipping_geometry.reward_dependent_masks: must not silently change action support between reward ablation arms
clipping_geometry.conditional_credit: for interacting rewards use explicitly defined factor/conditional objectives; additive toy does not establish general equivalence
clipping_geometry.kl_control: retain joint-sum KL in common profiles; family-budgeted KL is a separately registered experiment, never silently average by Q count

group_signal_diagnostics.population_reduction: Estimate constant-group expectations per request p(x)^G+(1-p(x))^G, then average with declared population weights; do not substitute dataset mean accuracy for p(x).
group_signal_diagnostics.phase_policy: First establish the registered Final-only RL curve from the fixed Stage1 start; compare fixed process-reward arms from the same start. No unregistered within-run reward switching.
group_signal_diagnostics.coefficient_warning: Shrinking a nonzero process coefficient may be largely canceled by GRPO group standardization in Final-constant groups.
group_signal_diagnostics.group_size_policy: Keep G16 candidate unchanged; G32 is only mechanism sensitivity here, not a newly selected training setting. Do not silently resample or discard constant-Final groups.
group_signal_diagnostics.stage1_gate: Record actual per-request probability and semantic competence at Stage1 exit; no numerical competence gate inferred from toy probabilities.
group_signal_diagnostics.scope: One process Bernoulli and gold-vs-rest Final, old=current; no claim about full panel or shared-backbone gradient budgets.

interacting_reward_credit.on_policy_identity: E[A_j(a_j)*grad_log_pi_j] = E[(R-E[R])*grad_log_pi_j] for factorized policy and exact conditional expectation under the same policy
interacting_reward_credit.variance_scope: per independent-logit coordinate versus same centered reward baseline; not shared-parameter total covariance guarantee
interacting_reward_credit.old_policy_surrogate: Freeze old probabilities and credits; marginal ratios define a separate local surrogate, not exact interacting current-policy expected reward away from old
interacting_reward_credit.interaction_scope: For R=sum_f r_f(a_neighborhood), compute conditional credits within each registered small factor support and sum; no claim of tractable full joint enumeration
interacting_reward_credit.consistency_reward: disabled_in_common_profiles; implication validity is diagnostic, not gold correctness
required_controls: same Final and process reward across credit estimators
same CE KL sampling and update budget
off-policy surrogate discrepancy and clipping reported
shared-backbone Final/process gradient and actual Final curves

stepwise_extensions.semantic_reward_revision: v3 fixed capacity per menu-v3; standard GRPO/RLOO/PPO advantages and joint clipping unchanged; no training integration.

release_gate.change_policy: No hot edits to running snapshots; engineering fixes require new version and affected acceptance checks; preserve version boundaries in curves.

release_policy.unaccepted_profile: not_dispatchable; optional critic integration does not invalidate an accepted critic-free release
release_policy.frozen_run_mutation: forbidden; fixes require a new version and affected acceptance evidence
release_policy.scope: design decision only; no profile is accepted by this registration

task_resolution_migration.historical_values: Retained for provenance; do not inherit I_class menus/denominators/definitions as semantic I_present settings. No new runnable profile created.
